description: Kibo UI is a custom registry of composable, accessible and open source components designed for use with shadcn/ui.

parts.name: announcement
parts.title: announcement
parts.description: A compound badge designed to display an announcement.

parts.name: avatar-stack
parts.title: avatar-stack
parts.description: Avatar Stack is a component that allows you to stack and overlap avatars.

parts.name: banner
parts.title: banner
parts.description: A banner is a full-width component that can be used to show a message and action to the user.

parts.name: calendar
parts.title: calendar
parts.description: The calendar view displays features on a grid calendar. Specifically it shows the end date of each feature, and groups features by day.

parts.name: choicebox
parts.title: choicebox
parts.description: Choiceboxes are a great way to show radio or checkbox options with a card style.

parts.name: code-block
parts.title: code-block
parts.description: Provides syntax highlighting, line numbers, and copy to clipboard functionality for code blocks.

parts.name: color-picker
parts.title: color-picker
parts.description: Allows users to select a color. Modeled after the color picker in Figma.

parts.name: combobox
parts.title: combobox
parts.description: Autocomplete input and command palette with a list of suggestions.

parts.name: comparison
parts.title: comparison
parts.description: A slider-based component for comparing two items in an overlay.

parts.name: contribution-graph
parts.title: contribution-graph
parts.description: A GitHub-style contribution graph component that displays activity levels over time.

parts.name: credit-card
parts.title: credit-card
parts.description: Credit card components for displaying and validating credit card information.

parts.name: cursor
parts.title: cursor
parts.description: A cursor component, great for realtime interactive applications.

parts.name: deck
parts.title: deck
parts.description: A Tinder-like swipeable card stack component with smooth animations.

parts.name: dialog-stack
parts.title: dialog-stack
parts.description: Composable stacked dialogs, useful for creating a wizard, nested form or multi-step process. It provides a consistent layout and styling for each dialog, and includes navigation component.

parts.name: dropzone
parts.title: dropzone
parts.description: Allows users to drag-and-drop files into a container to upload or process them.

parts.name: editor
parts.title: editor
parts.description: The Editor component is a powerful and flexible text editor that allows you to create and edit rich text content.

parts.name: gantt
parts.title: gantt
parts.description: The Gantt chart is a powerful tool for visualizing project schedules and tracking the progress of tasks. It provides a clear, hierarchical view of tasks, allowing you to easily identify manage project timelines.

parts.name: glimpse
parts.title: glimpse
parts.description: A component that shows a preview of a URL when hovering over a link.

parts.name: image-crop
parts.title: image-crop
parts.description: Helps you crop images to a specific size or aspect ratio.

parts.name: image-zoom
parts.title: image-zoom
parts.description: Image zoom is a component that allows you to zoom in on an image.

parts.name: kanban
parts.title: kanban
parts.description: A kanban board is a visual tool that helps you manage and visualize your work. It is a board with columns, and each column represents a status, e.g. "Backlog", "In Progress", "Done".

parts.name: list
parts.title: list
parts.description: List views are a great way to show a list of tasks grouped by status and ranked by priority.

parts.name: marquee
parts.title: marquee
parts.description: Marquees are a great way to show a list of items in a horizontal scrolling motion.

parts.name: mini-calendar
parts.title: mini-calendar
parts.description: A composable mini calendar component for picking dates close to today.

parts.name: pill
parts.title: pill
parts.description: A flexible badge component designed for a variety of use cases.

parts.name: qr-code
parts.title: qr-code
parts.description: QR Code is a component that generates a QR code from a string.

parts.name: rating
parts.title: rating
parts.description: A star rating component with keyboard navigation and hover effects.

parts.name: reel
parts.title: reel
parts.description: A composable Reel component that looks like Instagram Stories - a full-height, 9:16 aspect ratio container with video playback and progress indicators.

parts.name: relative-time
parts.title: relative-time
parts.description: A component that displays time in various timezones.

parts.name: sandbox
parts.title: sandbox
parts.description: The sandbox component allows you to preview and test components in a sandboxed environment.

parts.name: snippet
parts.title: snippet
parts.description: Snippet is a component that allows you to display and copy code in a tabbed interface.

parts.name: spinner
parts.title: spinner
parts.description: A spinner is a visual indicator that shows progress or activity.

parts.name: status
parts.title: status
parts.description: Status components are used to display the uptime of a service.

parts.name: stories
parts.title: stories
parts.description: A composable Stories component - a carousel of individual video cards like you'd see on Facebook.

parts.name: table
parts.title: table
parts.description: Table views are used to display data in a tabular format. They are useful for displaying large amounts of data in a structured way.

parts.name: tags
parts.title: tags
parts.description: Tags are a way to apply multiple labels to an item.

parts.name: theme-switcher
parts.title: theme-switcher
parts.description: A component to switch between light, dark and system theme.

parts.name: ticker
parts.title: ticker
parts.description: A composable finance ticker for displaying symbols, prices and changes.

parts.name: tree
parts.title: tree
parts.description: A composable tree component with animated expand/collapse and customizable nodes.

parts.name: video-player
parts.title: video-player
parts.description: A composable, shadcn/ui styled video player component that uses the media-chrome library.
